name: businessObjectRecords
description: Records from any Ivanti business object, including customer-defined ones, with all fields returned

getArgs.value: {{ Math.min((typeof maxRecords !== 'undefined' && Math.floor(Number(maxRecords))) || Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(dataSource.pageLimit) || 100)), Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(dataSource.pageLimit) || 100))) }}

ui.name: businessObject
ui.label: Business object name
ui.help: The business object name as used in the API, which is always the object name with an `s` on the end - `incidents`, `tasks`, `alerts`, `employees`. A customer-defined object follows the same rule.

pattern.message: Use the API name of the business object, e.g. incidents

ui.name: select
ui.label: Field(s)
ui.help: Limits the response to these fields, which is worth doing for objects with many columns. A field name that does not exist fails the whole request.

ui.name: maxRecords
ui.label: Maximum records
ui.help: Defaults to the page limit set on the data source, and is capped at it - a higher value is reduced to the limit rather than failing. Narrow the filter to see different records.
